widget.text: LinkBERT is an advanced fine-tuned version of the bert-large-cased model developed by Dejan Marketing. The model is designed to predict natural link placement within web content.
The Standard Model (SM) of [MASK] physics has been tested by many experiments over the last four decades and has been shown to successfully describe high energy particle interactions.
Clear evidence for the production of a neutral boson with a measured mass of [MASK].0 ± 0.4 (stat) ± 0.4 (sys) GeV is presented.
An excess of [MASK] is observed above the expected background, with a local significance of 5.0 standard deviations, at a mass near 125 GeV, signalling the production of a new particle.
On September 14, 2015 at 09:50:45 UTC the two [MASK] of the Laser Interferometer Gravitational-Wave Observatory simultaneously observed a transient gravitational-wave signal.
These first images from the EHT achieve the highest [MASK] resolution in the history of ground-based VLBI.
We propose a comprehensive theory of [MASK] matter that explains the recent proliferation of unexpected observations in high-energy astrophysics.

Formation of galaxy clusters corresponds to the collapse of the largest gravitationally bound overdensities in the initial [MASK] field and is accompanied by the most energetic phenomena since the Big Bang and by the complex interplay between gravity-induced dynamics of collapse and baryonic processes associated with galaxy formation.
The Event [MASK] Telescope (EHT) has led to the first images of a supermassive black hole, revealing the central compact objects in the elliptical galaxy M87 and the Milky Way.
